lesson: When PO number, amount, and date all match, approve the invoice even if the vendor name is not yet in the master; flag for vendor master enrichment rather than escalating (POL-00x).
Duplicate detection must use PO number + amount + date proximity as matching criteria regardless of vendor master status; missing vendor records do not prevent duplicate identification (POL-00x).
Escalate only when critical fields (PO match, amount, or date) are ambiguous or missing; a known PO with matching details should never escalate solely due to an unknown vendor (POL-00x).

Apply case-insensitive, punctuation-tolerant vendor name matching before escalating for 'vendor not found'; unresolved name variants that match an existing PO should be flagged for master cleanup, not escalated (POL-00x).
When a PO exists and matches, treat the vendor as established even if absent from the vendor master; escalate only the master-data gap, not the entire invoice. (POL-005)
Escalation is for ambiguous cases; a clear duplicate (same vendor + PO + amount) must be rejected outright. (POL-005)
Cross-check PO-4482 in the purchase-order master before escalating a vendor-not-found flag; a valid PO confirms an existing vendor relationship. (POL-005)
Escalation should narrow uncertainty, not broaden it; route unknowns to onboarding and route clear duplicates to rejection. (POL-005)
When a vendor enrichment flag is active, block approval until the vendor master record is complete; enrichment gaps are mandatory prerequisites, not optional enrichments (POL-0003).
Exact amount matches on open POs do not confirm invoice uniqueness; always cross-reference invoice date, line items, and vendor history for duplicate detection before approval (POL-0005).
When any category flag is raised—especially duplicate or unknown_vendor—the agent must reject or escalate rather than override based on partial criteria (POL-0002).
Verify the PO is open and the amount is within tolerance before approving (POL-002).
For invoices over $500, compare the invoice amount to the PO amount: approve only if within +/-2%, otherwise ESCALATE (POL-002). Never skip this check.

Call lookup_invoice_history for vendor+amount: if a match was processed 1-30 days strictly before the invoice date (same-day rows are the same record, not a duplicate) of the invoice date, REJECT as duplicate (POL-004).
A vendor absent from the master file is not a rejection trigger if a valid open PO confirms the vendor relationship
